about:
Most NetSuite consulting firms want clean, easy implementations.
 
We specialize in the “projects” that are already broken.
 
At Switchback Advisors, we help companies recover stalled implementations, simplify overengineered environments, and stabilize NetSuite systems that are no longer working for the business.
 
Over the last 20+ years, I’ve worked with organizations that were behind schedule, over budget, struggling with reporting, or losing confidence in their ERP system altogether.
 
Our approach is simple:
 • Senior people stay involved
 • Accounting and operational flow come first
 • Simplicity beats overengineering
 • Long-term partnerships matter
 
Services include:
 • NetSuite Implementations
 • Rescue & Recovery Projects
 • Managed Services
 • Reporting & Process Improvements
 • Integrations & Automation
 
Based in Michigan. Supporting clients throughout the U.S.

experiences.description:
Switchback Advisors is a boutique NetSuite consulting firm specializing in implementations, rescue projects, optimization, and managed services.

We help companies recover stalled implementations, simplify overcomplicated environments, improve accounting and operational workflows, and stabilize NetSuite systems that are no longer meeting business needs.

Our approach is highly hands-on with senior-level involvement throughout the engagement. We focus on practical execution, accounting-first system design, and long-term client partnerships instead of overengineering solutions.

Core Services:
• NetSuite Implementations
• Rescue & Recovery Projects
• Managed Services & Support
• Reporting & Process Improvements
• Integrations & Automation
• ERP Strategy & Advisory

Providing fractional CFO, accounting, and ERP advisory services for small and mid-sized businesses.

Supporting organizations with financial operations, month-end processes, account reconciliations, reporting, cash flow visibility, ERP systems, and operational improvements.

This work is often combined with broader ERP strategy, NetSuite optimization, and business process consulting.

Cloud Genius ERP, Michigan's NetSuite Solutions Provider, loves the cloud and helping organizations migrate there. We are a certified NetSuite Solution Provider and offer comprehensive services including NetSuite implementation and optimization services, business process analysis, ERP/accounting software selection services, cloud migration, strategy and integrations. 

NetSuite has proven itself as the global cloud ERP leader with One unified business management suite, encompassing ERP/Financials, CRM, and ecommerce for more than 30,000 organizations. 

We may not be real geniuses but we do love NetSuite, the cloud and helping organizations become more efficient.

Michigan's NetSuite Solution Provider, we love it so much it's the only solution we sell.  Oh ya, we use it too.  

For more information call or email me.

VP Professional Services | Director of Consulting Services | Consulting Services Manager (2011 – 2016)

Increased services revenue by 180% in 5 years for The TM Group through strategic growth initiatives of staff and products, operational/internal system tracking improvements and application of solid business know-how.

Established the NetSuite Practice in 2014 resulting in the acquisition of 12 new clients.  Grew staff by 3+ Consultants in 2 years.  Instrumental contributor to the evaluation and selection of new ERP product offerings. 

Led the Consulting Team for 5 years and managed overall team growth from 23 to 48 employees.  Added and integrated 3 new roles of CRM Practice Manager, ERP Practice Manager and Development Practice Manager

Selected by management to fulfill 3 Consulting leadership roles over 5 years in response to company growth while performing a broad scope of core responsibilities for project and practice management. 

Managed 30 Consulting Services Team members including Practice Managers for CRM, ERP and Development, Project Managers and ERP Consultants.  Conducted recruiting, hiring, development and quarterly performance measurements.  Oversaw all consulting projects to ensure proper management including but not limited to review of all timelines, project details, budgets and project communications through to product certification.  Developed and managed implementation of methodologies. Ensured top notch help desk operations in providing exceptional client and associate services.  Prepared and presented project status reports and revenue realization to the Leadership Team.

Implemented process improvements including internal tracking of consulting time and budget-to-actual reporting, and a project management collaboration tool.

Led client business process reviews and conducted needs assessments; included client system requirements and necessary changes/modifications. Analyzed and researched new and existing products, systems, procedures and work flow needs to recommend the best solutions and action plans.  Developed client test and production environments for live use, collected and imported master and transactional data extracts, conducted build and systems tests, assisted clients in testing and performed on-site user training for both key and end users.  Provided other software application consulting services including business process review, planning sessions, setup, testing, readiness assessment, data import/conversion, custom report needs and documentation. 

Executed and managed over 50 full life cycle Dynamics GP Implementations.  Collaborated closely with developers and end users, sales teams and customer support services to achieve project goals and best results.

Obtained expert level knowledge of all Dynamics GP core modules, distribution supply chain modules and others; included Integrations, Reporting and ISV products.

Performed full life cycle implementation with Great Plains Accounting; included installation, support and network management of accounting systems.  Implemented core modules GL, AP, AR and Bank Rec.  Provided support with PSQL 2000, SQL 6.5 and 7.0, Win 95, 98, NT 4.0 and 2000.
